patch_resolves_note: The staged GT already establishes that the fix resolves the MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value, but this assertion plan is derived only from the accepted trace, sanitizer trace, and vulnerable source.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: The parser finishes a non-multivalued parameter and passes the attacker-controlled parameter text into parameter-value materialization.

Each semicolon in the structured parameter value allocates another field and advances `st->num_fields` while storing through the fixed `field[20]` array without a recorded capacity check. The supported root invariant is that field construction can make the destructor trust `st->num_fields` over initialized field storage; the saved MSAN artifact proves the later destructor read, not a specific offending write index.
During final teardown, the destructor reads `st->field[i]` in `if (st->field[i])`, and the saved MSAN trace reports that read as a use of uninitialized value.
Intermediate runtime event parameter_structured_unref materialized from verified transition assertion transition.structured_object_reaches_destructor.

edges.description: When `vcardparameter_free()` calls `vcardstructured_unref(param->structured)`, that same structured object later reaches `vcardstructured_free()` where the destructor reads `st->field[i]`.
